events.title: Next Fest live · Day 7: let's build a campsite
events.summary: Hello, campers! Every day of Steam Next Fest we go live at 19:00 (Spain): we open the free demo, build a campsite from an empty beach, watch the guests live their holidays and answer your questions in chat. What we'll see Building, decorating and the life of the campsite by day and by night Postcard Mode: press P and send us your favourite corner Your questions and suggestions in chat The free demo is available until October 26, and Camping Resort Simulator arrives in Early Access on November 4.

events.title: Replay: building a campsite (not live) · Live again today at 7 PM CET
events.summary: Hello, campers! This is a replay of yesterday's Steam Next Fest stream, not a live broadcast. We built a campsite from an empty beach in the free demo and watched the guests settle in. 📺 We're live again today at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT · 1 PM ET), and every day until October 25. Come by and ask us anything in chat! 🏕️ The free demo is open until October 26, and Early Access opens on November 4. If you like what you see, a wishlist helps us a lot.

events.title: ⏳ Last weekend: 3 days left to play the free demo

events.title: Development Update #8 — Next Fest Update: All the Plants Are Yours
events.summary: All the plants are yours Hello, resort managers! 🌴 Steam Next Fest is in full swing, and we've just updated the free demo. Many of you asked for more ways to decorate your campsite, so here it is. 🌴 Every plant and tree, unlocked All the vegetation is now available in the demo: palms, trees, shrubs, hedges and flowers. events.title: Early Access opens on November 4
events.summary: We have a date. Camping Resort Simulator opens in Early Access on November 4, 2026. Until then, the free demo stays on Steam until October 26, the last day of Steam Next Fest. If you haven't tried it yet, this is the moment: build your first campsite on an empty coast, open the pool and the beach club, and follow your guests through their holiday. Thank you to everyone who has played, wishlisted and written to us. Your comments on the demo are shaping the Early Access build. Add the game to your

events.title: Development Update #7 — Which Camper Are You?
events.summary: Which camper are you? Hello, resort managers! 🌴 Spend a summer on any campsite and you'll meet them all: the family that never leaves the pool, the couple looking for a quiet sunset, the regulars who have had the same pitch for years. In Camping Resort Simulator they are seven kinds of guests, and each one wants something different from your resort. 🎒 Backpackers They travel alone with a tent and stay one night. Nature is what they come for. They watch every price, spend very little, and wander

events.title: Development Update #6 — The Demo Keeps Getting Better
events.summary: The demo keeps getting better Hello, resort managers! 🌴 Since the free demo came out we haven't stopped. We've released several updates in just a few days, every one of them based on your comments and on how the demo is actually being played. Here is what has changed. 🧭 A clearer start We've rebuilt the first steps. The game now guides you through your first two days step by step, with illustrated hints and markers right on your campsite, and then leaves you free to build your own way. 🎮 Control

events.title: 🏕️ Camping Resort Simulator is coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Camping Resort Simulator is coming to Steam Next Fest! Hello, future resort managers! 🌴 We’re incredibly excited to finally share some big news with you: Camping Resort Simulator will be taking part in Steam Next Fest! 🎉 And there’s something even more exciting... Our free demo is ready! 🏕️🎮 After more than a year of development, we’re getting ready to let you step into the resort and experience Camping Resort Simulator for yourself. 🌴 Build your own holiday resort Build and manage your own camp

events.title: Development Update #5 — A Resort Is Also a Business
events.summary: A Resort Is Also a BusinessA beautiful resort is only half the story.To keep it growing, it also has to work as a business.Every service you open, every building you place and every price you set has an impact on your accounts. events.title: Live: building a campsite from scratch
events.summary: Hello, campers! Today I'm opening Camping Resort Simulator live: we'll build a campsite from an empty beach, watch the guests live their holidays, and hunt for bugs and improvements together. What we'll see The new festival stage: truss structures, CampingFest banners, colored lights and smoke The stage's first performers: the magician and the party DJ Building, decorating and the life of the campsite by day and by night Your questions and suggestions in chat We're a very small studio and every

events.title: Development Update #4 — Your Guests Have Their Own Holiday
events.summary: Your Guests Have Their Own HolidayA resort isn't alive because buildings move around it.It's alive because people use it.Your guests arrive with their own expectations, needs and reasons for being on holiday. events.title: Development Update #3 — Every Detail Matters
events.summary: Every Detail MattersA camping resort is made up of much more than buildings and facilities.It is the combination of all the little things around them.The vegetation along a path. The lighting around an accommodation area. A bench beneath some trees. The decoration around the pool.
